purpose: Evaluate DeepSeek Flash on exactly the same uncapped blocks and shortest-path cases as Luna, with eight independent calls per case.
inheritance: Other API settings and all cases come from the saved suite generated using configs/pilot.json. No prompts, reference solutions, or sampling counts are changed.
reasoning_note: The inherited request uses medium. DeepSeek maps medium to its high thinking effort; this is not a claim of matched compute across providers.
budget_note: Retain the same requested output token cap. Inspect actual usage and truncations; the Luna gateway did not enforce the requested cap. Do not resample a budget-limited answer as a service error.
model_version_note: Official documentation checked 2026-09-06 identifies the current Flash alias as DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731. Preserve returned model fields in raw logs; the endpoint exposes a rolling alias.
